column1: # Public Chemical Manufacturing Datasets
By Scott Duncan. Reach me on LinkedIn here: https://www.linkedin.com/in/s-r-duncan/
Chemical manufacturing data is notoriously difficult to find because companies rarely make process data or engineering drawings public. This repository brings together useful
column2: publicly accessible datasets for developing and testing AI

column1: Two sections:
1. **P&IDs**: actual piping & instrumentation diagrams from real permitted facilities.
2. **Time series**: process datasets for fault detection
Inspired by [awesome-industrial-datasets](https://github.com/jonathanwvd/awesome-industrial-datasets).
## P&IDs
Every one of these is a water treatment facility
column2: which is not a coincidence. If you discharge treated water to a river or the ground you need a permit
column3: and the permit application goes into a public docket along with the supporting engineering drawings.

## Contributing

Know a public dataset that belongs here? [Open a dataset suggestion](https://github.com/ScottDuncanAI/public-chemical-manufacturing-datasets/issues/new?template=new-dataset.yml) — the form asks for the link
column3: and what condition it is in. The bar is that it has to be publicly downloadable without a license agreement or an NDA.
